text: Still frame 8.7× the baseline headless (5.67 → 0.65 s); on the user's iPhone the composite scene settles in 18 ms, orbits in 1–2 ms and bakes in 109 ms. Strict image gate fails on 4 scenes (sharp creases, thin rims) since earlier kept steps: being repaired first. The 4-jug piece crashed the iPhone right after its field changed at rest; fixes are live in Clay Preview, awaiting a rerun. Editing (drag frames) is now measured: about as slow as a still frame, since the bake can't help mid-drag.
noise: Noise: 5 baseline runs of the composite scene, 5552–5777 ms (σ ≈ 1.5%). A change must beat the incumbent by > 3% and hold on a confirmation run.
